{{Quote|Our clone intelligence units have discovered the location of General Grievous. He's hiding in the Utapau system.|Chancellor [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]|<ref name="Episode 3">{{Film|III}}</ref>}}
'''Clone Intelligence''' were the espionage [[unit]]s in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
{{Quote|Hasn't Clone Intelligence reported this weapon never leaves any survivors?|Chancellor Palpatine, on the ''Malevolence''|<ref name="som">{{TCW|Rising Malevolence|Rising ''Malevolence''}}</ref>}}
Clone Intelligence [[unit]]s were created by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and consisted of different types of [[Cloning/Legends|clones]] for information gathering missions on [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] activities. Clone types included the early-though-rare [[Null-class Advanced Recon Commando|''Null''-class Advanced Recon Commandos]] and the more numerous [[Clone shadow trooper/Legends|clone shadow troopers]]. Early in the war, the Clone Intelligence units were too few to be truly useful, forcing the Republic to rely on the [[Bothan Spynet/Legends|Bothan Spynet]] and other intelligence agencies. During this time, Clone Intelligence was known to had reported directly to the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].<ref name="RotSn">[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode III ''Revenge of the Sith'' novelization]]</ref>

When the Confederate ship [[Malevolence/Legends|''Malevolence'']] began destroying Galactic Republic [[Starship/Legends|starships]], Clone Intelligence reported that the enemy ship left no survivors in its wake.<ref name="som" /> After the ship's destruction, they later reported the sighting of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] at [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]].<ref name="rook">{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}}</ref>

[[File:Pau City Sinkhole.png|thumb|left|270px|Clone Intelligence located Grievous on Utapau.]]
By the closing stages of the Clone Wars, Clone Intelligence informed [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] about General Grievous' hideout on [[Utapau/Legends|Utapau]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. They had gathered this information by intercepting a partial message in a diplomatic packet from the [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] of Utapau. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] expressed his unease that Clone Intelligence reported the matter directly to the Supreme Chancellor, though [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] pointed out that the [[Security Act amendment]] to the [[Galactic Constitution/Legends|constitution]] meant that the Chancellor now held the position of Supreme Commander of the Grand Army of the Republic. This therefore meant that Clone Intelligence were following correct procedure by reporting to him instead of the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]].<ref name="RotSn" />
